_doc: The application evaluator runs each case as a baseline/no-skill arm and a with-skill arm, then grades behavior against expected_flags, expected_fix_hints, absent_signals, and the per-case criteria checklist.
subject: Applying chosen keywords and merchandising decisions to Etsy listing fields — title, the 13 tags, category/attributes,…

cases.scenario: A user asks: "Optimize an Etsy listing title, description, attributes, and 13 tags without exceeding the 20-character tag limit"
cases.context: The agent has access to the etsy skill and must decide whether to use it, apply its procedure, and stay inside its boundaries.
cases.question: What should the agent do, and why is etsy the right skill to apply?
expected_flags: Recognizes etsy as applicable to this request
Uses the skill-specific purpose or mental model instead of generic advice
Names the relevant boundary against seo-strategy, printify, keywords
Turns the request into concrete steps, checks, or decisions from the skill
expected_fix_hints: Apply the etsy workflow to the concrete scenario
State the next action and the evidence or verification needed
Call out any adjacent skill that should own a different part of the request
absent_signals: Does not answer with generic advice that could ignore etsy
Does not route to seo-strategy, printify, keywords when the etsy scope is the owner
Does not invent certification, freshness, or runtime success claims without evidence
